verdict.rationale: DPMA's own application pages address applicants directly in plain language, explaining filing routes (online with or without a signature card, or paper), accelerated examination, the one-year internal-priority window and the translation deadline. That goes beyond bare statute text and form numbers. However, the excerpts are fragmentary notes and do not show a structured step-by-step walkthrough a founder could follow end to end, and some of the online-filing tooling is German-only. missing for 10: evidence of sequenced step-by-step guides per task, founder-oriented explainer depth, full English availability, independent or hands-on confirmation of readability.
